snippet.title: PROJECT VESPERI - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Project Vesperi is a third-person, story-driven interactive game where your choices matter. Led by a small team of students, this proof of concept turned indie game debut from Last Praetorian Interactive is being built in Unreal Engine 5. 

Wishlist Now!
STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536670/Project_Vesperi/
EPIC GAMES STORE: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/project-vesperi-c8d013

Discover a sign of life on Venus and forge your own path in this exciting branching-narrative experience where choices matter. Each character can live or die, depending on your choices. Play again and again to discover entirely different conclusions based on the decisions you make throughout the story.

Disclaimer: All footage in this trailer is real-time in-engine, a work-in-progress, and not indicative of the final product.

Learn more:
Website: www.vesperigame.com
Twitter: @VesperiGame
Instagram: @VesperiGame
TikTok: @VesperiGame
